myBio.name: my-bio
myBio.content:
### About Me

> I design and ship **production-ready platforms end to end** — from database to deploy.
Hi! I'm Denilson De La Rosa, a **full-stack developer** and **Computer Systems Engineer** from Veracruz, Mexico.

I design and ship **production-ready platforms end to end**: high-performance **Bun + Elysia APIs** with Drizzle and PostgreSQL/MySQL, **Stripe payment flows**, **AI-assisted pipelines** (LLM editing, web scraping, Telegram bots), and polished frontends in **Svelte, React and Vue** — plus **React Native** mobile apps and **Tauri** desktop apps.

Recent work includes sales-team platforms with KPIs and rankings, a gamified promo backend synced with Salesforce, a news-automation system that publishes to WordPress on autopilot, fintech apps for kids, and open-source Stripe tooling.

If you need someone who can own a feature from database to deploy — let's talk. What are you building?

experience.name: experience
experience.content:
### Experience

> 2+ years, **15 shipped projects** across backend, frontend, mobile and desktop.
**Freelance Full-Stack Developer · 2023 — Present**

For 2+ years I've shipped **15 projects** as a freelance developer across backend, frontend, mobile and desktop — mostly client work, plus open-source tooling.

**Backend & APIs (core specialty)**
My go-to stack is **Bun + Elysia + Drizzle + PostgreSQL/MySQL**: 6+ APIs in production-style use with JWT auth, rate limiting, OpenAPI docs, cron jobs, S3 uploads, transactional emails and Firebase integrations. I also maintain Node.js/Express + Sequelize services.

**Payments**
Stripe is a recurring theme: a **Live → Sandbox catalog migration CLI** (idempotent product/price sync, open source), and a **checkout + service-landing platform** built with TanStack Start, React 19 and MySQL.

**AI & automation**
Built a **news-ingestion pipeline** (SearXNG search + Crawl4AI scraping + embeddings + LLM editing) with a Telegram-bot workflow that publishes to **WordPress on autopilot**, plus AI-assisted features (emotion detection, GenAI content) in client apps.

**Frontend, mobile & desktop**
A **SvelteKit + Tauri 2** desktop metrics app (charts, PDF/Excel export, native notifications), **Vue/Nuxt + Ionic/Capacitor** apps, **React + TanStack** platforms, and **Expo/React Native** mobile apps — including **SCANTEATE** (socio-emotional support for autistic children, InnovaTecNM national finalist) and **KidCash/Educash** (financial health for kids).

**How I work:** TypeScript-first, Biome lint/format, Vitest tests, Drizzle migrations, Docker, Linux + Nginx deploys, Git. I scope work clearly, communicate in English and Spanish, and document every API with OpenAPI.

Open to full-time roles and freelance engagements.

hobbies.name: hobbies
hobbies.content:
### My Passions & Pursuits

> Volleyball, cycling and hiking fuel my body — **music, meditation and reading** fuel my mind.
When I'm not immersed in the daily grind, you can find me diving into a variety of activities that fuel my mind, body, and soul.

There's nothing quite like the thrill of **volleyball**, whether I'm on the court bumping, setting, or spiking. It's a fantastic way to stay active and connect with others.

When I crave open air and scenic views, I love hitting the trails on my **bike**. There's a unique sense of freedom that comes with cycling, especially when exploring new paths. And for a true challenge, I enjoy **hiking up hills**. The ascent is always rewarding, offering breathtaking vistas and a profound sense of accomplishment at the summit.

Beyond physical activity, I find immense joy in the simple pleasure of **listening to music**. Whether it's setting the mood for a quiet evening or providing the soundtrack to a vigorous workout, music is a constant companion. To recenter myself and find inner calm, I dedicate time to **meditation**, a practice that helps me stay grounded and focused. And, of course, a good book is never far from reach. **Reading** allows me to explore new worlds, gain fresh perspectives, and continuously learn.

What are some of your favorite ways to unwind and recharge?
